blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— More than 130,000 minimum wage earners in the Ilocos Region will receive a daily pay increase of P35 to P40 under a new wage order expected to take effect on Dec. 14. Wage Order No. I-25 (Ilocos Region) grants a P40 increase to workers in non-agricultural establishments with 10 or more employees, raising their daily minimum wage from P505 to P545, according to a Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) announcement on Wednesday. DOLE said agricultural workers and employees of non-agricultural establishments in the region with fewer than 10 workers will receive a P35 increase in two […]...
